# CoinMarketCap

> > CoinMarketCap is the leading cryptocurrency data platform providing real-time prices, market capitalizations, charts, and analytics for thousands of digital assets across multiple blockchains.

CoinMarketCap offers comprehensive market data and tracking tools for cryptocurrencies, tokens, NFTs, and blockchain protocols. The platform serves investors, traders, and researchers with live pricing, historical data, technical indicators, and specialized market insights including DeFi yields, token unlocks, and real-world asset tokenization.

## Key Topics

- Bitcoin
- Ethereum
- Market Capitalization
- Cryptocurrency Prices
- Technical Indicators
- Fear and Greed Index
- Altcoin Season Index
- Total Value Locked (TVL)
- DeFi Yields
- NFT Statistics
- Token Unlocks
- Blockchain Rankings
- Real-World Assets (RWA)
- Crypto API
- CMC Labs

## Core Market Data & Rankings

- [Cryptocurrency Prices, Charts And Market Capitalizations](https://coinmarketcap.com): Main homepage with crypto prices, charts, and market cap data for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and thousands of altcoins.
- [Live Cryptocurrency Charts & Market Data](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts): Live crypto charts with Bitcoin dominance, altcoin season data, and real-time market sentiment.
- [Cryptocurrency Spot Market Data](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/spot-market): Spot market data with trading volumes, CEX/DEX activity, and historical performance analytics.
- [See The Top Crypto Gainers And Losers Today](https://coinmarketcap.com/gainers-losers): Top performing and worst performing cryptocurrencies in the last 24 hours with real-time rankings.
- [Cryptocurrency Sectors by 24h Price Change](https://coinmarketcap.com/cryptocurrency-category): Browse cryptocurrency sectors and categories ranked by 24-hour price changes and market performance.
- [What Are The Trending Cryptocurrencies On CoinMarketCap?](https://coinmarketcap.com/trending-cryptocurrencies): Discover trending cryptocurrencies based on price action and search data on CoinMarketCap platform.

## Historical Data & Analysis

- [Check Cryptocurrency Price History For The Top Coins](https://coinmarketcap.com/historical): Historical price and market cap data for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies since 2013.
- [Cryptocurrencies Tracked by CoinMarketCap](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/number-of-cryptocurrencies-tracked): Total cryptocurrency count tracked by CoinMarketCap with historical growth and chain-specific data.

## Blockchain & Protocol Data

- [Largest Blockchains in Crypto Ranked by TVL](https://coinmarketcap.com/chain-ranking): Blockchains ranked by total value locked (TVL) with protocol counts and valuation movements.
- [Public Companies Bitcoin Treasuries](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/bitcoin-treasuries): Public companies' Bitcoin holdings with real-time data on corporate BTC reserves and adoption.

## DeFi, Yields & Tokenomics

- [Crypto CeFi, DeFi and Stablecoin Yield Rates](https://coinmarketcap.com/yield): Compare DeFi, CeFi, and stablecoin yield rates for Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, and other crypto assets.
- [Token Unlocks and Vesting Schedules](https://coinmarketcap.com/token-unlocks): Token unlock schedules and vesting information for major cryptocurrency projects and tokenomics.
- [Top Tokenized Real World Assets (RWA) by Market Capitalization](https://coinmarketcap.com/real-world-assets): Track tokenized real-world assets like real estate, bonds, and commodities on blockchain networks.

## New & Upcoming Projects

- [New Cryptocurrencies Listed Today And This Week](https://coinmarketcap.com/new): Recently listed cryptocurrencies including mineable coins, ERC-20 tokens, and DeFi projects.
- [Best Upcoming Cryptocurrencies](https://coinmarketcap.com/upcoming): Browse upcoming cryptocurrency projects launching on Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and other blockchains.

## NFTs & Digital Assets

- [Highest Price NFT Stats - Collections and Individual Sales Listed](https://coinmarketcap.com/nft): NFT statistics including highest auction prices, collection data, and individual asset sales.
- [Upcoming NFT Collections](https://coinmarketcap.com/nft/upcoming): Upcoming NFT collections with launch dates, times, and blockchain hosting information.

## Optional & Specialized Tools

- [What Are The Most Viewed Cryptocurrencies on CoinMarketCap?](https://coinmarketcap.com/most-viewed-pages): Most viewed cryptocurrencies based on real-time CoinMarketCap user activity and page views.
- [Crypto Prediction Markets - Track Market Predictions](https://coinmarketcap.com/prediction-markets): Crypto prediction markets data aggregator tracking politics, crypto, economics, and sports markets.
